description: This file contains a PHP class definition for the Report controller within the OpenCart admin module. It handles the display and management of various reports in the admin interface, including loading language files, models, and rendering views.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: The main class responsible for generating the report overview in the admin panel, extending the base Controller class and implementing the index() method to build and render the page.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Builds the report page by setting up language, breadcrumb navigation, loading report modules, sorting them, and rendering the view.
